name: Field Doctor-Style Banana Peanut Butter Bar (Low FODMAP)
ingredients:
155 g Peanuts
110 g Organic Brown Rice Syrup
60 g Organic Rice Protein
3 1/2 tbsp Bananas
2 1/2 tbsp Soy Protein Crisps
1 1/2 tbsp Peanut Protein
1 1/2 tsp Himalayan Salt
2/3 tsp Pure Banana Oil
directions:
1. Prep: Line a small tray/tin (for 8 bars) with baking paper.

2. Mix: Process nuts/seeds if needed, then mix with syrup/binder, protein blend, flavourings and any chocolate/fruit pieces until a sticky dough forms. Warm the syrup slightly if the mix is too stiff.

3. Press: Firmly press into the tin in an even layer. Chill until set (about 1–2 hours, or overnight).

4. Cut: Cut into 8 bars. Keep refrigerated up to a week, or freeze. Inspired by Banana Peanut Butter Bar — gluten-free / Low FODMAP friendly recreation.
description: Inspired recreation of Field Doctor Banana Peanut Butter Bar.
